shortDescription: GTCR is a private-equity sponsor of Mega Broadband Investments. "Cable One Nears $1.25 Billion Financing Deal," on Oct. 8 at 2:12 p.m. ET, and updates at 4:39 p.m. and 5:16 p.m., incorrectly said GTCR was a private-equity sponsor of Cable One.
